Exploration consists of randomly selecting a small portion of inspections to allow the system to learn about products it would not otherwise identify. This helps expand the system's coverage of products, as shown by the increase from 261 to 280 different products. It occurs as part of the daily inspection process, where 10% of inspection slots are randomly chosen. The exploration does not involve fraud detection but rather enhances the system's learning capability.
